panels.description: Evening in the hopeful 2070 future at Alex’s modest Oasis house: pearl-white curved architecture, terraced gardens, a still reservoir, snow mountains behind, a distant rocket launch and a delivery drone. On the terrace, Alex’s Daughter is about nine years old, with warm-brown skin, freckles, brown eyes and long curly dark-brown hair. She wears an orange zip jacket with H2O patches over a teal ringed-planet shirt, dark cargo trousers, orange-and-black sneakers and a smartwatch. Her small, lively silhouette leans forward toward objects and stands on tiptoe at the wall. Her signature detail is the homemade plant-watering contraption built from bent spoons, pipe, a marble, a cup, a lever and a watering can. Alex Phantum is in his mid-forties, grey at the temples, with a day’s stubble, a worn brown work jacket over a dark henley, jeans and brown boots; he remains dressed like a mechanic rather than a polished executive, and the watch remains on his left wrist. Alex watches her with a slow half-smile. Keep the upper-right air above Alex clear for lettering.

Inside the Oasis-built hallway, pearl-white curved walls and warm wood floor. Alex and his daughter stand before a wall covered in framed patents and clippings; she is on tiptoe studying them. A tall window shows Oasis, Halyard and Keel all green and prosperous. Keep the upper-left wall area clear for Alex’s balloon.

Three framed newspaper clippings fill the hallway wall, arranged from upper-left toward lower-right with drawn photos. Leave the text areas inside the frames clean for lettering: PHANTUM WATERWORKS: 4,000 KEEL JOBS CREATED; PATENT ROYALTIES FUND 300 NEW FOUNDERS; CLEAN-WATER PRICES DROP 60% AND HEALTH IMPROVED. No figures or balloons.
The daughter turns from the invention wall toward Alex, curious and impressed. Keep a clean pale wall area above her and to her left for her speech balloon; keep her face unobstructed.
